title: Attach and fresh-attach dedupe
summary: Attach local and remote collections, deduplicate natural matches, and reuse the path only after confirmed replacement creation.
produces: Reference rewiring, epoch persistence, and after-merge report

conditions: Explicit tombstones and fresh-attach exclusions are honored.
Dedupe and reference rewiring preserve all intended data.
Repeated ambiguous ties continue to be reported.
Replacement attach cannot run before confirmation and successful POST.
W8 never initiates backup export or bypasses user consent.
completion.summary: PR #1280 is merged and all W8 implementation conditions are evidenced; ADR-004/W14 completion is now recorded, satisfying W8's declared dependencies.
evidence: packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_merge_test.dart covers normalized-title and choreography matching, deterministic survivor selection, source-citation identity, survivor provenance, collection unions, and equal-time ambiguity reporting.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart covers fresh-attach reference rewiring, aliases, program slots, links, pending-tombstone exclusions, review-queue reconciliation, and batched FTS cleanup before losing-row deletion.

app/test/sync/sync_coordinator_test.dart covers fresh attach, replacement confirmation, attach continuation, stale-epoch deferral, publication failure retry, baseline persistence ordering, and the production single-flight boundary.

The fresh-attach durability guard was mutation-proven: inserting replaceBaseline before continuation manifest publication made the failed-publication retry test red; restoring the committed implementation made it green.
The tracker validator and its mutation-proven validation suites pass, and python3 tools/preflight.py passes all 30 available steps.
ADR-004/W14 completion evidence is recorded in .github/tracking/adr-004/units/W14.json; W4, W5, W6, W7, W14, and W18 are complete, satisfying every declared W8 dependency.
